newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish September reserves rise to 83.9 bln crowns.
newsitem.headline: Danish September reserves rise to 83.9 bln crowns.

text.p: Denmark's foreign exchange reserves rose to 83.9 billion crowns at end-September 1996 from 78.6 billion crowns at end-August 1996, according to the central bank's monthly balance sheet released on Wednesday.

NOTE - The central bank said it had paid back a net 400 million crowns in foreign loans in September. The September foreign reserves compared with average analysts' expectations of 83.8 billion crowns, not taking into account state loan transactions.
